long_biography.plain_text:
V-Nee Yeh studied history at Williams College and law at Columbia before joining Lazard, where he worked in corporate finance, capital markets and risk arbitrage. Returning to Hong Kong in 1990, he reorganised his family's Hsin Chong interests and led a management buyout, combining an established family platform with his own transaction experience.

In 1993 Yeh co-founded Value Partners around an underdeveloped Asian value-investing market. He later co-founded Argyle Street Management for distressed and special situations and helped establish Cheetah and other specialist managers. His working style favours launching ideas, building teams and handing stable operations to trusted partners while retaining chairman or advisory roles.
